GOVERNMENT NOTICE No. 271 Published On. 19/3/2021
THE FOREST ACT,
(CAP. 323)
_______
ORDER
_______
(Made under section 22(1))
THE FOREST (IYONDO MSWIMA FOREST RESERVE) (DECLARATION) ORDER, 2021
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Forest (Iyondo
Mswima Forest Reserve) (Declaration) Order, 2021.
Declaration
2. The area of general land within the limits and
boundaries defined in the Schedule to this Order is hereby
declared as Iyondo Mswima Forest Reserve.
GN. NO. 271 (Contd.)
__________
SCHEDULE
___________
(Made under paragraph 2)
ILEJE DISTRICT
IYONDO MSWIMA FOREST RESERVE
Approximate area: 2935.694 Hectares or 29.357 Square Kilometres
Situation and Boundaries
All that area of general land formerly under Iyondo Mswima Forest situate in the Ileje district,
Songwe region as delineated on survey division Map No. Jb 2983 of 2020 (Scale 1:20000)
deposited with the Director of Surveys and Mapping Division of the Ministry of Lands, Housing
and Human Settlement Development, Dodoma and bounded as follows:
